answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 30392 Country: India Title: Is it good to offer asr salat behind shafee imam when its not time to offer asr in hanafi? Can a hanafi offer asr salat according to shafee time? Question: Is it good to offer asr salat behind shafee imam when its not time to offer asr in hanafi? Can a hanafi offer asr salat according to shafee time? Answer ID: 30392 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 376/276/L=1432) A Hanafi follower should offer Asr salah after mislain (when the shadow of an object is double of its size) according to the Hanafi maslak. It is not right to offer Asr salah behind a Shafi'i Imam at Misl Awwal (when the shadow of an object is equal to its size). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
